themes.scope: U.S. listed companies classified in the Communication Services sector. The sector ETF anchor follows the corresponding Select Sector SPDR mandate.
excluded: Companies outside the sector fund’s published holdings; ETF holdings participation is not an exhaustive measure of every company in this sector.
themes.anchor_rationale: State Street’s Select Sector SPDR XLC is the plain long-only equity ETF for the Communication Services sector. Its official daily holdings file supplies the dated breadth universe. Selection follows stated mandate, not recent performance.
themes.representation_limit: The Select Sector SPDR fund holdings define the ETF breadth sample. Industry classification views separately cover categories represented in the dated S&P 500 constituent table.
themes.representation_status: S&P 500 and official sector ETF holdings intersection

themes.rank_method: ThemeScore descending; unavailable scores last; stable ID tie-break

themes.name: Energy
themes.scope: U.S. listed companies classified in the Energy sector. The sector ETF anchor follows the corresponding Select Sector SPDR mandate.
excluded: Companies outside the sector fund’s published holdings; ETF holdings participation is not an exhaustive measure of every company in this sector.
themes.anchor_rationale: State Street’s Select Sector SPDR XLE is the plain long-only equity ETF for the Energy sector. Its official daily holdings file supplies the dated breadth universe. Selection follows stated mandate, not recent performance.
themes.representation_limit: The Select Sector SPDR fund holdings define the ETF breadth sample. Industry classification views separately cover categories represented in the dated S&P 500 constituent table.
themes.representation_status: S&P 500 and official sector ETF holdings intersection

themes.name: Information Technology

themes.representation_limit: The Select Sector SPDR fund holdings define the ETF breadth sample. Industry classification views separately cover categories represented in the dated S&P 500 constituent table.
themes.representation_status: S&P 500 and official sector ETF holdings intersection

limitations: 17 dated primary ETF anchors are included across 11 standard sectors and curated industry/theme exposures. Current and Medium are price-return percentiles among eligible anchors; breadth and curated stock lists are independent evidence layers.
S&P 500 list is a reproducible current Wikipedia table, not an official point-in-time membership feed. Its as-of is the retrieval observation date.

Sector and industry summaries are equal-company descriptions of currently listed S&P 500 constituents, not whole-market rankings or validated trading scores. Industry names are the source table’s GICS Sub-Industry labels.

ETF holdings breadth is equal-company participation of the official equity holdings universe, not whole-industry breadth. Incomplete foreign listing mappings reduce breadth coverage but do not affect ETF score or eligibility.
IWM holdings breadth uses the current official iShares IWM ETF holdings file as a practical Russell 2000 proxy; it is not official Russell 2000 constituent breadth.
VIX is a separate volatility context series with no constituent breadth or ETF score/state dependency.
Yahoo adjusted close and split conventions are vendor definitions; there is no guaranteed availability or publication delay.
Nasdaq does not supply a separate market-cap field timestamp; stock eligibility is provisional.
Curated company-theme classifications use recorded Core/Related rationale and source; non-anchor members are allowed. Holdings are not a membership gate.
Scores are fixed ranking conventions, not validated entry signals, predictions or portfolio allocations.

source.asof_basis: Current constituent page observed at retrieval; not an official effective-date assertion

classification_catalog.method: Equal-company descriptive aggregates. Return columns are medians of split-adjusted constituent returns; breadth is the share of constituents with retrieved prices that close above their own EMA. This is an S&P 500 subset, not whole-market industry breadth.

candidate_metrics.name: Communication Services
candidate_metrics.scope: U.S. listed companies classified in the Communication Services sector. The sector ETF anchor follows the corresponding Select Sector SPDR mandate.
excluded: Companies outside the sector fund’s published holdings; ETF holdings participation is not an exhaustive measure of every company in this sector.
candidate_metrics.anchor_rationale: State Street’s Select Sector SPDR XLC is the plain long-only equity ETF for the Communication Services sector. Its official daily holdings file supplies the dated breadth universe. Selection follows stated mandate, not recent performance.
candidate_metrics.representation_limit: The Select Sector SPDR fund holdings define the ETF breadth sample. Industry classification views separately cover categories represented in the dated S&P 500 constituent table.
candidate_metrics.representation_status: S&P 500 and official sector ETF holdings intersection

candidate_metrics.name: Industrials
candidate_metrics.scope: U.S. listed companies classified in the Industrials sector. The sector ETF anchor follows the corresponding Select Sector SPDR mandate.
excluded: Companies outside the sector fund’s published holdings; ETF holdings participation is not an exhaustive measure of every company in this sector.
candidate_metrics.anchor_rationale: State Street’s Select Sector SPDR XLI is the plain long-only equity ETF for the Industrials sector. Its official daily holdings file supplies the dated breadth universe. Selection follows stated mandate, not recent performance.
candidate_metrics.representation_limit: The Select Sector SPDR fund holdings define the ETF breadth sample. Industry classification views separately cover categories represented in the dated S&P 500 constituent table.
candidate_metrics.representation_status: S&P 500 and official sector ETF holdings intersection
